jj.candidate.checks.text: {card} came back from its jj candidate on {target}: its merge check {check} failed on the candidate.{log, select, none {} other { Last lines: {log}}}{path, select, none {} other { Its whole log: {path}}} Fix it in your change with jj (bring {target} in first if the failure is in how they combine), commit and submit again (cw_submit). Combwork builds a new candidate and runs its checks once it is approved again.
jj.candidate.checks.note: HI-2938: a jj card's builder is told its approved card came back to it: Combwork built the change onto its target bookmark ({target}) and the project's merge check {check} (its name) failed on that result. {card}: its key. {log}: the check's last lines (none: left out). {path}: its log file (none: left out). jj is the tool's name; cw_submit is a tool's name.

jj.candidate.returned.text: {card} came back from its jj candidate on {target}: {why, select, conflict {it conflicts with {target}} notUpToDate {it isn't up to date with {target}} other {{why}}}{files, select, none {} other { (in {files})}}.{log, select, none {} other { Last lines: {log}}} Bring {target} into your change with jj (rebase it onto {target}, or merge {target} in), resolve any conflict, commit and submit again (cw_submit). Combwork builds a new candidate once it is approved again.
jj.candidate.returned.note: HI-2871: a jj card's builder is told its approved card came back to it: Combwork built the change onto its target bookmark ({target}) to check it before the user integrates it, and it conflicts or isn't up to date. {card}: its key. {why}: the reason (keep the select keys). {files}: the files concerned (none: that part is left out). {log}: the last lines of what jj said (none: left out). jj is the tool's name; cw_submit is a tool's name.
